name: How can I prevent black soot from recurring on my walls?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent black soot from recurring on my walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing recurring black soot involves addressing its source. For candles, ensure they are trimmed, burned in well-ventilated areas, and not left burning for extended periods. Regularly service your furnace and other gas appliances to ensure efficient combustion and proper venting. Maintain good ventilation in your home, especially in kitchens and near fireplaces. If you smoke indoors, consider alternatives or improve ventilation. Identifying and mitigating the specific source is key to long-term prevention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent recurring soot by trimming candle wicks, ensuring proper appliance maintenance, improving home ventilation, and addressing indoor smoking habits.
